operations.details: Verified official OGC PUCK Protocol page.
Instrument identification separated from measurement calibration.
Driver/configuration metadata not promoted to terrain accuracy.
PUCK metadata requires independent calibration and observation evidence.
Verified official OGC Sensor Planning Service page.
Sensor tasking workflow separated from resulting observation values.
Task status not promoted to measurement-quality evidence.
Observation accuracy requires actual result, lineage and uncertainty evidence.
PUCK and SPS URLs confirmed absent from prior source registry.
No tasking or device metadata substituted for terrain measurement.
Canonical manifest untouched; serial publisher required.
